cards.text: Elisha, the LORD's prophet in Israel, comes to Damascus. Over there, Ben-hadad, king of Aram, is sick. And word gets to the king: 'The man of God has come here.'
So the king calls Hazael, one of his men, and tells him to take a gift, go meet the man of God, and ask the LORD something through him. The king has ONE question on his mind.

cards.question: Ben-hadad is sick, and the man of God is in town. What does the king want Hazael to ask the LORD through Elisha?

answers.text: Whether he will recover from this illness
Who will reign over Aram after him

cards.question: Hazael goes to meet Elisha with a gift of forty camel loads of every good thing from Damascus.

cards.text: Back in the Millers' kitchen, where I stamped cookies for years, ONE batch for a new neighbor was us going ALL out, and this man shows up with FORTY CAMEL LOADS! Hazael stands before Elisha and asks the king's question, word for word.

cards.question: Hazael asks Elisha whether the king will recover. What does Elisha tell Hazael to go say to the king?
Then Elisha adds one more thing for Hazael: the LORD has shown him that in fact Ben-hadad will ___.

cards.text: Then Elisha fixes his gaze on Hazael and holds it until Hazael gets uncomfortable. It's like when your boss says 'Got a minute?' and then just LOOKS at you for WAY more than a minute.

cards.question: After that long, steady stare at Hazael, Elisha the man of God begins to ___.

cards.text: Hazael asks him, 'Why is my lord weeping?' Friend, if a prophet stared me down and started crying, I'd be asking too, and LOUDLY.

cards.question: Why is Elisha weeping as he looks at Hazael?

answers.text: He knows the evil Hazael will do to Israel
He misses his home and family in Israel
He cannot accept such a large gift

cards.text: Elisha spells it out: 'You will set fire to their fortresses, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little ones to pieces, and rip open their pregnant women.' I think this one hurts, friend.

cards.question: Elisha tells Hazael he will burn Israel's fortresses and kill its people. Hazael asks how he, calling himself a mere dog, could do such a monstrous thing.
Hazael asks how he could ever do such a thing. Elisha answers with something else the LORD has shown him. What is it?

answers.text: Hazael will be king over Aram
Hazael will fall in battle soon

cards.text: So Hazael leaves Elisha and goes back to his master. The king asks him, 'What did Elisha say to you?'

cards.question: Back with his master, Hazael tells the sick king that the LORD has shown Elisha the king will die.

cards.text: Hazael just tells him, 'He told me that you would surely recover.' But the next day, Hazael takes a thick cloth, dips it in water, and spreads it over the king's face.

cards.question: Ben-hadad king of Aram dies, and ___ reigns in his place.
